text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's the day of the Hanshin J.F., and Hishi Amazon is feeling the pressure after seeing how ready and formidable her competition is.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But then, she remembers that her dormmates are cheering her on—and she resolves to not let them down.
